note: Both sets cover all nine Table 5-1 properties with accurate values and supporting quotes, so the difference is in redundancy and binding. Set A keeps the fully-deployed condition on the brake torque and has only one redundant rotor-speed claim, while Set B repeats the rotor speed three times and binds the brake time constant to 'High-Speed Shaft' rather than the brake. Set B's added 'rated' conditions are harmless but redundant with the property names, and it drops the explicit fully-deployed condition. Overall Set A is marginally cleaner and more faithful.
